fact_text: Sazgar Engineering reported close to PKR 400 of earnings per share in FY26, which on the prevailing price put the stock on roughly five times earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst warned that two changes effective 1 July 2026 could cut Sazgar's earnings per share from about PKR 400 towards PKR 200, so a low headline multiple overstates how cheap the stock is.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because the new auto policy was delayed, sales tax on hybrids and plug-in hybrids in Pakistan reverted to 25% from the earlier 8.5% to 12.5% band, forcing assemblers to raise prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sazgar assembles the Haval range in Pakistan, including the Tank, H6 and Jolion, whose hybrid and plug-in hybrid versions are the models exposed to the higher sales tax while petrol versions are not.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Range-extender electric vehicles and pure electrics keep a 1% sales tax in Pakistan for a further year, so their prices are unaffected while hybrid and plug-in hybrid prices rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Haval has no range-extender vehicle in its global line-up, so Sazgar cannot copy rivals who benefit from the 1% sales tax on that technology, leaving it unable to absorb the tax shock through product mix.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The 2016 auto policy gave new entrants, in a market then limited to Honda, Toyota and Suzuki, a 20% reduction in duty on imported vehicle kits for five years, expiring on 30 June 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: On a PKR 10 million Sazgar vehicle, cost of sales runs about PKR 7.5 million, of which roughly PKR 6.8-7.0 million is the imported kit including duty, so the kit dominates the cost structure.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: With the greenfield concession gone, Sazgar's kit duty moves from a 10-15% range to roughly 30%, lifting kit cost on an illustrative PKR 10 million car from about PKR 7.0 million to PKR 8.0 million.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst therefore models Sazgar's gross margin falling from about 25-26% to roughly 13-16% once the duty concession expires, since assembly adds only around PKR 0.5 million of other cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Not all Sazgar models sat inside the greenfield plan: the Tank and some plug-in hybrid versions never received the 20% duty relaxation, which is why the post-expiry margin lands in a range rather than a point.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the analyst's worst case, with hybrid sales tax left at 25%, Sazgar sells about 1,000-1,100 cars a month, roughly 12,000-13,000 in FY27, on a 14-15% gross margin, giving earnings near PKR 150 per share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If a notification sets hybrid and plug-in hybrid sales tax at 18%, the analyst sees Sazgar selling about 15,000 cars in a year and earning close to PKR 200 per share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the best case, where the auto policy is approved with below 10% sales tax on hybrids, volumes return to 1,500-2,000 cars a month and better fixed-cost absorption lifts gross margin to 17-18%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sazgar delivered only 663 vehicles in July 2026 against 1,500-2,000 a month previously, which the analyst read as policy uncertainty freezing sales rather than a permanent demand loss.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When a tax change is pending, an assembler either raises prices and risks angry customers if relief later arrives, or sells at the lower tax and must fund the tax shortfall out of its own profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A plug-in hybrid kit costs more dollars than the equivalent petrol kit, and the analyst estimates roughly 2,000 kilometres of battery driving, about two years for an average user, to repay that extra import outflow in fuel savings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The extra import cost of an electric two-wheeler's battery pays back in under six months of fuel savings, far faster than a plug-in hybrid car, so the analyst argues policy support is better directed at bikes.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Duties and sales tax on vehicle sales are a major component of Pakistan's federal tax collection, which the analyst says makes deep sales-tax concessions on expensive cars fiscally and politically hard to grant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst notes the IMF would see a 1% sales tax on a PKR 8-10 million car as a subsidy to the rich while motorcycle users pay a petroleum levy of around PKR 80 per litre.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst judged a 1% or 5% sales tax on hybrids and plug-in hybrids unlikely and saw a balanced outcome of roughly 15% to 20% as the more probable policy landing point.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects Sazgar to offset part of the tax shock with new launches in FY27, naming the Tank 300, the Cannon Alpha pickup and petrol versions of existing models, worth perhaps PKR 40-70 per share.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because petrol and diesel versions of the Tank exist in Haval's global range, Sazgar can switch mix towards internal-combustion versions if hybrids become too expensive after the tax rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistani taxes rise steeply above 2,000cc, so the Tank 500's globally common 3.0 litre petrol version would be priced unattractively if brought to Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sazgar also has access to the Ora electric brand, but that badge has not yet gained customer traction in Pakistan and full-electric adoption still faces practical obstacles.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sazgar has been investing heavily in assembly capacity and is typically among the first countries to introduce a newly launched Haval model, which gives it an unusually fast product cycle for Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues the IMF-backed plan to open used-car imports and cut duties caps the multiple local assemblers can earn, so good current earnings may still be valued below the market's 9-10 times.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Around 5,000 bookings had been reported for the Tank, and the analyst expected a 12-15% price increase to thin that order book somewhat without destroying demand.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst treats a policy change that splits input or tax costs between competitors as a trajectory-changing event, citing the 2024 gas price differential between FFC and Engro Fertilizer as the template.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's read of 2025 is that Pakistan's improved geopolitical position after the India-Pakistan conflict plus falling interest rates ended an early-2025 sideways phase and drove a strong rally from July 2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 reduced super tax, which mechanically lifts listed company profits without any operational improvement, a change the analyst had flagged in advance.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's rule when a major policy change lands is to re-examine which companies become structural beneficiaries or losers and move capital accordingly, rather than hold a view through the change.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Sazgar Looks Undervalued... But This Risk Changes Everything' (YouTube transcript, undated)
